title: Day 3: keep 50 g
vo: Day three, at about 9 in the morning. You may see bubbles and smell something sharp. Weigh 50 grams of it into your clean spare jar, and discard the rest. Feed it 50 grams of wholemeal rye flour and 50 grams of water at about 26 degrees. Stir, mark the level, cover loosely, and leave it for a day.
voUS: Day three, at about 9 in the morning. You may see bubbles and smell something sharp. Weigh 50 grams of it, about three and a half tablespoons, into your clean spare jar, and discard the rest. Feed it half a cup of wholemeal rye flour and three and a half tablespoons of water at about 79 degrees. Stir, mark the level, cover loosely, and leave it for a day.
cap: Day 3, 9 am: weigh 50 g into your clean spare jar and discard the rest.
Feed it 50 g wholemeal rye flour and 50 g water at about 26 °C. Stir, mark and cover.
capUS: Day 3, 9 am: weigh 50 g (3½ tbsp) into your clean spare jar and discard the rest.
Feed it ½ cup wholemeal rye flour and 3½ tbsp water at about 79 °F. Stir, mark and cover.
